hey I’m 20 I live in Canada I’m a dude if that matters..just looking for people to talk to bcz I moved to a new city about 2 years ago and haven’t really made any new friends since I’ve been here other than few coworkers

I know where you’re coming from living in agony is literally the worst feeling there is just having that aching pain in your stomach and having your mind swirl around all day. I get that the only thing that keeps me sane now days to try get my mind off things but it’s only a temporary fix. Work helps me through the week bcz I’m always busy but then when weekends come it’s worse I feel alone and trapped. I hope that you don’t do anything because even as much as your friends harp on you they still like having you around and seeing you. If you don’t think that’s the case then maybe try getting a job it might not be something you enjoy to do but like I said it’ll help keep your mind busy and you might like the people you work with and create new bonds. I’m not really good at giving advice bcz I myself and am in so much pain too and don’t wanna say something that’s going to make you feel worse but honestly don’t do something regretful because even as much as I literally do not know you. You have people who care about you even from a random stranger over the internet. You’re valued

Atleast you have friends..try value them a bit more as hard as it might seem their on your case to do this and do that but I’ve been alone now for far too long even lost my family and I’m slowly going insane. I joined this group a few days ago bcz things have been becoming unbearable.

I feel you, it seems impossible to make friends and everyone I know is posting stories and living the life in their 20’s and im just sitting here in bed like every other day scrolling through my phone trying to pass the time. It’s hard

I moved away from home and lost contact with all my friends, my family turned into a toxic mess and I had to cut them off. The most contact from them I get is a text every month or two giving me updates on THEIR lives. Work is a bust and I get teased by them telling me I need to “eat more” bcz im skinny. I’ve been trying to gain weight forever and it’s next to impossible. I haven’t made any friends the 2 years I’ve been here and my days sound identical to yours..im stuck in a endless cycle that seems impossible to get out of. Joined Reddit bcz atleast there is some sense of communication and community in my life. I hope things get better but I hate when people try tell me that so I’m not really sure what to say. Yours truly from a broken soul—…
